name: cove
description: Cove — a private, end-to-end encrypted, real-time messaging web app.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w web && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=240000 e2e/*.test.ts
